diagnosis.narrative: The series is dominated by a strong downward trend (a net fall of ~297% of its level). There is little seasonal structure. The series is quite predictable: its energy concentrates in a few structured frequencies. The series reads as ambiguous by the ADF/KPSS tests. Across validation windows the model ranking is unstable (Kendall tau 0.29), which favours a robust combination.

Test a median combination on the stable pool1 to see if a robust, low‑variance method can beat the single FT_rf.
Test a median combination on pool2 to see if expanding the pool improves robustness.
Test a robust median combination on the larger pool3 to see if expanding the model set improves robustness.
Test a robust median on the largest pool (pool4) to see if adding catboost improves robustness.
Test a simple mean over the largest pool (pool4) to see if averaging all 9 models gives better robustness than the current median winner.
Test a robust DBA combination on the larger pool4 to see if it can beat the current median pool1 leader.
Test a weighted combination using inverse_error weights on the larger pool4 to see if giving more weight to low‑error models improves over the current leader.
Test a median combination on pool5 to see if adding catboost improves robustness.

decision.justification: Selected 'median on pool1' (an agent proposal) as the best of 22 backtested attempts, score 0.8806. Series context: trend strength 0.9275 and seasonal strength 0.2816; model ranking is unstable across windows (Kendall tau 0.29); 2 of 19 models carry independent error; relative error spread across the pool is 0.781.
